statement.p: Parameterize the plane that contains the three points (4, -3, 4), (-2, -6, -6), and (5, 35, 10).

p.em: (Use s and t for the parameters in your parameterization, and enter your vector as a single vector, with angle brackets: e.g., as \lt 1 + s + t, s - t, 3 - t \gt.)

static.solution:
P=(4, -3, 4), Q=(-2, -6, -6), and R=(5, 35, 10) are the displacement vectors \vec v_1 =\vec{PQ} = \left\lt -6,-3,-10\right> and \vec v_2 = \vec{PR} = \left\lt 1,38,6\right>.
Letting \vec r_0 = \left\lt 4,-3,4\right>, we have the parameterization \vec r(s, t) = \vec r_0 + s\vec v_1+t\vec v_2 = \left\lt 4-6s+t,38t-\left(3+3s\right),4-10s+6t\right>.
